_comment: Rates used to convert seats and units into dollars. Edit freely - every figure rendered downstream records which basis it came from, so changing a rate here changes the deck without touching code.
_basisOrder: An account's own observed price always wins. These are the fallback when an account has no billing history.

copilotBusiness.source: GitHub Docs - billing for Copilot in organizations and enterprises

copilotEnterprise.source: GitHub Docs - billing for Copilot in organizations and enterprises

aiCredit.source: GitHub Docs - usage-based billing, additional AI credits

secretProtection.source: GitHub Docs - Secret Protection pricing calculator

derived._comment: GitHub Enterprise has no public per-seat list price. These are medians observed across the install base in rev_source, and are labelled 'derived' wherever they appear.

assumptions._comment: Sizing judgements a reviewer may want to challenge. Stated explicitly rather than buried in code.
assumptions.ghasSkuRationale: Code Security is the broader SKU and the usual first GHAS motion; switch to secretProtection to size the entry-point deal instead.
assumptions.copilotTierRationale: Business is the conservative default; Enterprise roughly doubles the per-seat value.
assumptions.aiuAttachRationale: AIU upside from NEW seats is not modelled by default because included credits cover typical usage. Existing measured AIU spend is annualised from real invoices instead.
